articles.title: 700 Meters Underground, a 20,000-Ton Ghost Trap Just Rewrote the Neutrino Rulebook
articles.summary: JUNO, a massive underground detector in China, released its first physics result. It measured neutrino oscillation parameters with 1.6× better precision than decades of prior work. The finding validates the detector for its main goal: determining the neutrino mass ordering.

articles.title: One Degree of Warming, Three Extra Weeks of Melt: Alaska's Glaciers Send a Stark Signal
articles.summary: Satellite radar reveals that each 1°C rise in summer temperature lengthens Alaska's glacier melt season by roughly three weeks. Heat waves strip up to 28% more protective snow, accelerating ice loss.

articles.title: The Rice Paradox: Why Your Dinner Gets Weaker When You Squeeze It Fast—and How That Could Build Smarter Robots
articles.summary: Packed rice exhibits 'rate softening'—it weakens under rapid compression. Scientists combined it with sand to create a metamaterial that adapts its stiffness without electronics, opening doors for soft robotics and smart protective gear.
